{{Quote|An eight-year old boy on Takobo has captured the hearts of the entire Galactic community by organizing a fundraiser for a new orbital cannon. The event drastically exceeded its goal after investors from around the Core have stepped in to match local bids. The cannon will begin construction later in the year.|Dorna Parros, HoloNet News|audio=Takobo-Outlaws.flac|<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref>}}
'''Takobo''' was a [[planet]]<ref name="The Future of the Force" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> that was home to a number of emigrated [[species]], including [[Ithorian]]s. The peaceful world boasted [[color]]ful [[Classical architectural Hutt style|architecture]] with a mix of modern and classical designs.<ref name="Databank" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War]], two [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]], the [[Seventh Sister]] and the [[Fifth Brother]], captured a [[Force-sensitive]] Ithorian named [[Pypey]] from the Ithorian settlement known as [[Hammertown]]. The infant was [[Duel in Hammertown|rescued]] by [[Ezra Bridger]] and other members of the [[Spectres|rebel crew]] of the [[starship]] ''[[Ghost]]''.<ref name="The Future of the Force" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Takobo first appeared in "[[The Future of the Force]]," an episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. [[StarWars.com]] hinted that the planet was named Takobo because the dining option available on the day of the episode's writing conference was a taco bar.<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/the-future-of-the-force-trivia-gallery|text="The Future of the Force" Trivia Gallery}}</ref> Most of the Takobo sets were based on unused ones of the [[moon]] [[Pantora]] during ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Art of">''[[The Art of Star Wars Rebels]]''</ref>
